name: @alexgorbatchev/pi-quick-answer
description: Pi extension to quickly extract questions, options, and decisions from the assistant's last response for prompt answering
author: Alex Gorbatchev

scripts.test: bun test && PI_OFFLINE=1 bun x pi --no-extensions -e ./src/index.ts --list-models > /dev/null 2>&1
scripts.test:local: bun x pi -e ./src/index.ts "Provide a 2-paragraph technical explanation of why we isolate Docker networks in Coolify and how multi-network containers can cause Traefik gateway timeouts. At the end of your response, present 3 concrete solutions and questions to me."
